solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: What duelling pistols had, indicated in report

parts.note: a loaded duelling pistol had a bullet, the shot it fired
taken as written

explanation.surface: A news report describes duelling pistols that were loaded, as was indicated.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'What duelling pistols had' as a loaded pistol: it had a BULLET IN it. 'indicated' simply links that reading to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A bulletin is a short official news report or announcement.

clue.text: Boil turning blue, black and brown, primarily

indicators.note: turning suggests the letters of blue, plus the two picked letters, are churned into a new order
primarily asks for the opening letter of each of black and brown

explanation.surface: A boil on the skin turning blue, black and brown, like a bruise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boil' looks like a noun for a skin sore; here it is the verb. 'primarily' gives B and B from black and brown, and 'turning' shuffles BLUE with them.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquid that boils froths and seethes, which is what it does when it bubbles.

clue.text: Brave circus performer like Daniel was

definitions.meaning: a circus artiste who works in the ring with big cats
in the Bible Daniel spent a night unharmed among the beasts in the den, as if he had mastered them

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is a playful one: Daniel, thrown into the den in the Book of Daniel, came out unharmed, as though he had mastered the big cats.
explanation.definitionFit: A brave circus artiste who controls big cats in the ring with a whip and chair.

clue.text: A male involved in weird sex tests

indicators.note: involved in places one group of letters inside another
weird signals that the letters of sex are put in an odd order

explanation.surface: A man caught up in some strange sexual experiments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'weird' turns SEX into EXS, and 'involved in' places A and M (male) between the X and S.
explanation.definitionFit: Examinations are formal tests of knowledge, as taken at school or university.

clue.text: Unfortunately in confusing play about time

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: about means the jumbled letters go around another letter
confusing indicates the letters of play are jumbled

explanation.surface: Sadly, someone is caught up in a puzzling play about time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confusing' rearranges the letters of 'play' to APLY, and 'about' puts that round the time letter, giving APTLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Something said inaptly is put unsuitably or awkwardly, which is close to unfortunately chosen.

clue.text: Possibly a queen's favourite time to relax

definitions.text: Possibly a queen's favourite time to relax

parts.words: Possibly a queen's favourite time to relax
parts.note: a queen is also a female cat, so her favourite way of resting would be a short doze of the feline kind

explanation.walkthrough: 'queen' suggests royalty, but a queen is also a female cat, and a short doze is named after cats.
explanation.definitionFit: A short light sleep taken during the day, the kind of brief rest cats are famous for.

clue.text: Water pressure on road causing skid

parts.note: aqua is Latin for water
P is the abbreviation for pressure in physics
a lane is a narrow road

explanation.surface: Standing water on the road makes cars slide out of control.
explanation.definitionFit: To aquaplane is for a vehicle's tyres to slide on a film of water, a kind of skidding.

clue.text: Portrait in water colours? Not much to look at!

definitions.meaning: a picture done in watercolours is literally not one done in oils
an idiom for a person who is plain or unattractive

explanation.walkthrough: The first reading is taken literally: a watercolour portrait is a picture not done in oils. The second is the familiar British idiom for someone who is plain-looking.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a person of plain looks, someone who is far from beautiful.

clue.text: See 7
Shoot dead to really impress

definitions.meaning: slang for killing someone with a gun
an idiom for astonishing or thrilling someone

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both to kill by shooting and, informally, to amaze someone completely.

clue.text: Just half join party with soldier in martial costume

indicators.note: half takes the first two of the four letters of Just

parts.note: a do is an informal word for a party
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier in combat dress joining a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'join' and 'with' are only link words here, and 'Just half' takes the front half of that word.
explanation.definitionFit: A judogi is the loose white jacket and trousers worn for judo, a martial art.

clue.text: Man out of Genesis takes part in Beatles' audition

indicators.note: takes part in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A man from the band Genesis gets a part in an audition for the Beatles.
explanation.walkthrough: Genesis looks like the rock band, but it is the first book of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Esau, elder twin of Jacob, is a figure in the Book of Genesis.

clue.text: Many don uniform in Yogi's position

indicators.note: to don is to put on, so the larger word wears the other letter inside it

parts.note: lots means many
U is uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Lots of people put on uniform to strike a yoga pose.
explanation.definitionFit: The lotus is a cross-legged seated posture used in yoga and meditation.

clue.text: Unlikely top titles for one occupying 21

indicators.note: unlikely signals that the words top titles are rearranged into something unexpected

explanation.surface: Someone improbable picking up the top honours.
explanation.walkthrough: 21 is the down entry COCKPIT, where a pilot sits.
explanation.definitionFit: A test pilot flies new aircraft from the cockpit to check their performance.

clue.text: Spymaster sounds cheerful

definitions.meaning: George ... is John le Carre's fictional spymaster
an adjective meaning happy and smiling a lot

explanation.walkthrough: George Smiley runs British intelligence in John le Carre's novels; 'sounds' just joins the two meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: Le Carre's spy chief shares his surname with an informal adjective for a grinning, happy person.

clue.text: There's nothing to equal romantic marriage

parts.note: love means zero in tennis scoring
to match something is to equal it

explanation.surface: Nothing beats a marriage for love.
explanation.definitionFit: A love match is a marriage made from affection rather than money or status.

clue.text: Extremely understanding, as well as an African

indicators.note: extremely asks for the letters at the two extremes of understanding

parts.note: and means as well as

explanation.surface: Someone from Africa is very understanding.
explanation.definitionFit: A Ugandan is a person from Uganda, a country in East Africa.

clue.text: Uses ducking stool? One lowers beam with it

definitions.meaning: read as a sentence, someone dips a witch, the old punishment of plunging a suspect into water on a chair
a car's control that drops the headlights from main beam

explanation.walkthrough: A ducking stool was a chair on a pole for plunging suspected witches into water. A dip switch is the British name for a car's headlight dimmer.
explanation.definitionFit: The car control that dips the headlights so oncoming drivers are not dazzled.

clue.text: Mostly rich contents of 25

indicators.note: mostly means the answer is largely, but not wholly, the same as the word for rich

parts.note: affluent means rich

explanation.surface: Wealthy people form most of the contents of a Western.
explanation.walkthrough: A loose device: 'Mostly' says the answer shares most of its letters with AFFLUENT, differing only in the first. 25 is the across entry SEWER, read as a drain.
explanation.definitionFit: Effluent is liquid waste or sewage, which is what flows through drains.

clue.text: Till hell freezes over, or is consumed by heat

indicators.note: is consumed by puts one piece inside another that swallows it

parts.note: a fever is a raised body heat

explanation.surface: Something lasting until hell freezes over, or else burns up in the heat.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names a time that never comes, so it means for all eternity.

clue.text: Capital of two American states

parts.note: RI is the postal abbreviation for Rhode Island
GA is the postal abbreviation for Georgia

explanation.surface: A capital city shared by two US states.
explanation.definitionFit: Riga is the capital city of Latvia on the Baltic.

clue.text: Free speech, as exemplified in some tweets

indicators.note: free suggests the letters of speech are let loose and rearranged

explanation.surface: Free speech in action on social media, in posts on Twitter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tweets' looks like social media posts; here it is birdsong.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheeps are the short high calls of young birds, a kind of tweeting.

clue.text: Where the Chanticleers once fought

parts.note: Chanticleer is the traditional name for a rooster in fables, so the place is the pit for cockfighting

explanation.walkthrough: Chanticleer is the rooster of medieval fable, as in Chaucer; cockfights were held in a sunken arena.
explanation.definitionFit: A cockpit was originally the enclosed pit where roosters were set to fight.

clue.text: Dealer turned up example of Socialist Realism?

indicators.note: in a down entry, turned up means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: red means socialist and art is what Socialist Realism is an example of

explanation.surface: A dealer unearths a piece of Soviet-style propaganda art.
explanation.walkthrough: Socialist Realism was the official Soviet art style; read as 'red art' and turned up it gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A trader buys and sells goods, so is a dealer.

clue.text: Supernaturally, as the Wise Men came, initially

parts.note: like means as, in comparisons
the Magi are the Wise Men of the nativity story

indicators.note: initially asks for the first letter of came

explanation.surface: The Wise Men arrived as if by supernatural means.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done as if by sorcery happens mysteriously and instantly, beyond natural explanation.

clue.text: Silent killer following Stanley perhaps

definitions.meaning: a blade is a quiet weapon, and the word also opens with a silent letter
Stanley is a brand of utility blade, so the word that follows Stanley in that tool's name

explanation.walkthrough: A Stanley knife is the British name for a utility box-cutter. 'Silent' also nods to the unsounded first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A bladed weapon kills without noise, and it is the word that completes the tool name after Stanley.

clue.text: Tailor who features in more Westerns from the east

indicators.note: in an across entry, from the east means reading right to left
features in says the letters appear inside the words of the phrase

explanation.surface: A tailor turns up in more Western films.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from the east' turns the hidden REWES backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: One who sews is a needleworker, which a tailor is.

clue.text: Father's new woman, fascinating but dangerous

parts.note: to sire is to father, and a sire is a father

explanation.surface: Dad's new partner is alluring but risky.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the Sirens lured sailors to death, so a seductive, perilous woman is a femme fatale.

clue.text: Is showing discrimination, first to last

indicators.note: first to last means the opening letter is shifted to the end

parts.note: sexist means discriminating on grounds of gender

explanation.surface: Someone shows prejudice by always putting themselves first and others last.
explanation.definitionFit: To exist is to be, so the plural verb is a synonym of 'is' in the sense of being.

clue.text: Vigorous spider weaves with it

indicators.note: weaves suggests the letters are interlaced into a new pattern

explanation.surface: An energetic spider spins a web with it.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirited means lively and full of energy.

clue.text: Get through the first set, maybe

definitions.text: Get through the first set, maybe

parts.words: Get through the first set, maybe
parts.note: a baby's first set of milk teeth come through the gums

explanation.walkthrough: 'first set' suggests tennis; it is the first set of teeth breaking through a baby's gums.
explanation.definitionFit: Babies cut their milk teeth as these push through the gums.

clue.text: An oil carrier's said to be this when in port

indicators.note: said means the words are spoken and what is heard is written down differently

parts.note: a tanker is a ship that carries oil

explanation.surface: A supertanker is described as being moored when in harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic British accent the two phrases sound the same.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship moored by its anchor in harbour is stationary in port.
